description: Real U.S. DOJ press-release titles (retrieved 2026-10-04 via justice.gov API, see tests/fixtures/http) hand-labelled by the project maintainers with the role of the named company. 'subject' = the company is the target of the reported action; 'victim' = the company was harmed; 'mentioned' = incidental/unclear.
